name: Somchai Srisuk
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport security was somewhat unconventional. Growing up near the Buriram United International Circuit, he initially volunteered as a track marshal, developing a keen eye for detail and a deep understanding of safety protocols. His methodical approach and unwavering commitment quickly caught the attention of security personnel, leading to opportunities to assist with logistical planning and crowd control. He demonstrated an exceptional aptitude for identifying potential risks and implementing preventative measures, eventually earning a full-time role with a regional racing team.

Joining Ferrari AF Corse is a dream come true for Somchai. He approaches his role with a blend of quiet confidence and unwavering dedication. He believes in proactive security measures, focusing on meticulous planning, thorough risk assessments, and fostering a culture of safety consciousness among the team. His perfectionist tendencies drive him to constantly improve security protocols and ensure the well-being of everyone involved.

Somchai's technical understanding of racing vehicles, combined with his management skills, allows him to implement security measures that are both effective and minimally disruptive to the team's operations. His innovative approach to security, such as utilizing advanced surveillance technology and predictive analytics, sets him apart from his peers.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped hair with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Somchai is of average height with a wiry build, giving him a quick and agile appearance.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down potential security risks or improvements.
Has a habit of polishing his security badge when he's feeling stressed.
Insists on conducting a thorough security sweep of his office every morning, even though it's already been checked.
